user.title: Yahoo Finance setup
user.description:
Enter the symbols to track.

Note: requests can fail in some GDPR regions.

data_description.symbols: Separate symbols with commas, spaces or new lines, using Yahoo Finance ticker format. Optionally add `:CUR` to convert to another currency and/or `:nounit` to drop the unit, e.g. `AAPL`, `LGEN.L:USD`, `GBPUSD=X:nounit`, `EMIM.L:EUR:nounit`.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch prices from Yahoo Finance (minimum 30 seconds). Add another Yahoo Finance entry if some symbols need a different interval.

error.invalid_symbol: `{symbol}` is not a valid entry. Use `SYMBOL`, optionally followed by `:CUR` and/or `:nounit`.
error.symbol_in_use: Already tracked by another Yahoo Finance entry: {symbol}
error.interval_too_short: The update interval must be at least 30 seconds.

init.title: Yahoo Finance options
init.description: Update tracked symbols and display options.

data_description.symbols: Separate symbols with commas, spaces or new lines, using Yahoo Finance ticker format. Optionally add `:CUR` to convert to another currency and/or `:nounit` to drop the unit, e.g. `AAPL`, `LGEN.L:USD`, `GBPUSD=X:nounit`, `EMIM.L:EUR:nounit`.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch prices from Yahoo Finance (minimum 30 seconds). Add another Yahoo Finance entry if some symbols need a different interval.
data_description.manual_update: Only refresh when the `yahoofinance.refresh_symbols` action is called.
data_description.decimal_places: Use -1 to disable rounding, 0 for whole numbers.
data_description.target_currency: Three-letter currency code applied to symbols without their own `:CUR`. Leave empty to keep the reported currency.
data_description.show_trending_icon: Use trending up/down/neutral icons instead of the currency icon.
data_description.show_currency_symbol_as_unit: Use the symbol (e.g. $) instead of the code (e.g. USD) as the unit.
data_description.show_off_market_values: Use the pre/post market price as the sensor value when it is more recent than the regular market price.

error.invalid_symbol: `{symbol}` is not a valid entry. Use `SYMBOL`, optionally followed by `:CUR` and/or `:nounit`.
error.symbol_in_use: Already tracked by another Yahoo Finance entry: {symbol}
error.interval_too_short: The update interval must be at least 30 seconds.
error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. EUR.

refresh_symbols.name: Refresh symbols
refresh_symbols.description: Fetches the latest data for all Yahoo Finance symbols.
